chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn al-Hamid, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Three (people), Allah will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Judgment, nor purify them, and for them is a painful punishment: an aged adulterer, a tyrannical king, and a stingy arrogant one.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Allah will not speak to on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights three archetypes of spiritual ruin: the elderly sinner who fails to leverage their experience for piety, the tyrannical ruler whose power becomes a tool of oppression, and the miserly individual whose wealth breeds arrogance rather than generosity. In Shia scholarship, these categories illustrate how specific life stages and social roles can become sources of divine neglect if not coupled with humility and righteousness. The emphasis on 'mukhallal' (arrogant miser) underscores the spiritual danger of hoarding wealth while maintaining a haughty demeanor, a theme frequently linked to the rejection of zakat and social responsibility.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Three (people), Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Speak to them, nor Look towards them on the Day of Judgment, nor will He<sup>azwj</sup> Purify them, and for them would be a painful Punishment – an aged adulterer, and a tyrannous king, and an arrogant self-denying one’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Ja’far has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from ‘Asim ibn Humayd from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The messenger of Allah has said, ‘There are three kinds of people to whom, on the Day of Judgment, Allah will not speak or look to and will not purify them. They will suffer a painful punishment: an old man who fornicates, a tyrant king and an arrogant poor person.”
